display_name: LoRa 与 WiSig 共用源域对比表征选择器筛查
description: 同一整包门控结合实增益、R17 和物理作用残差；以源 U 同包模拟双视图自监督表征与 clean 参考误差构造无 TX 标签选择目标。
authorization: 用户要求两个数据集使用通用融合方法，优先 R02/R07/R17；显存充足立即启动并保护其他 owner。

code.environment: N607 CVS-RFFI CUDA FP32 / TF32 off, CPU independent scorer

data.contract_ref: lora_rx5_main_v1:392005; ManySig Main original 7/63/30 F0 seed392005; VALIDATED_ONCE source caches
data.representation: same SharedPacketSelector and source-only contrastive feature target; LoRa 8x1024 and WiSig 8x32 with separate source-trained experts and weights
data.physical_ids_ref: existing first cross-data screen physical IDs, same paired channel observations
data.exposure: same source V RX panels and historical comparisons repeatedly exposed by prior development; no target input or truth

permissions.claim_scope: Same source-only loss and separate head weights. LoRa real-gain expert inherited authorized E104-guided supervised/pseudolabel training; WiSig real-gain expert is F-free. No F weights or TX labels accessed for new head training; frozen original classifiers only during prediction; source V truth only after all row predictions freeze.

checkpoint.initialization: Identical zero-logit SharedPacketSelector initialized independently per dataset; tie selects R17. No cross-dataset weight transfer.

sources.role: WiSig original full R17 and action
LoRa E104 real-gain screen comparison only
WiSig frozen DURA v1 same-packet screen predictions
frozen same-ID LoRa-trained R69 architecture adaptation; distinct from original WiSig DURA v1 weights

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source final step 1000. LoRa hard-scene net >=1 in each fixed half and clean >=-1 versus every available same-packet control including LoRa R69 adaptation. WiSig each half net >=2 and clean >=-2 against each control including fixed DURA v1. Original fixed WiSig DURA v1 checkpoint has no lawful matched LoRa transfer; disclose as unavailable.

execution.gpu_policy: Two distinct GPUs from [2,3,6,4], each >=8192 MiB free; excludes GPUs 7 and 1 used by the earlier owner run and preserves other owners.
execution.stop_rule: Stop affected run on provenance/data-contract mismatch, occupied immutable output, no source-only checkpoint smoke, nonfinite loss/gradient, prediction matrix mismatch, query or truth-boundary violation; preserve partial artifacts and all other processes.

rows.method: same SharedPacketSelector trained by lower clean-relative distance in a learned source-U two-view contrastive representation

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 400 encoder updates plus 1000 selector updates x batch 4; two simulated views per encoder record and one simulated view plus clean input per selector record

rows.method: same SharedPacketSelector trained by lower clean-relative distance in a learned source-U two-view contrastive representation

data_overrides.training: U_s only; no TX or classifier

rows.seed_notes: Support inapplicable; preregistered existing source V observations and fixed paired half permutation.
rows.budget_ref: 400 encoder updates plus 1000 selector updates x batch 24; two simulated views per encoder record and one simulated view plus clean input per selector record

notes: One shared packet selector, source-only encoder architecture, physical residual feature, training loss and inference rule; dataset-specific expert adapters and independently trained weights.

Training-only encoder: gain/phase invariant magnitude and consecutive-sample phase increment, adaptive 256-point representation, shared convolutional encoder and two independently simulated observations of the same U packet as positive; different packets in batch are negatives and may share TX. Symmetric contrastive loss, 400 updates.

Encoder frozen. For each simulated source U pair select the expert with smaller clean-relative embedding MSE; train selector for 1000 updates and also train on clean input. AdamW 0.0003, seed 2026112921; only current packet is used at inference and training encoder is not deployed.

Training reads no pretrained F, TX labels, source V or target. LoRa real-gain expert inherited previously authorized E104 guidance and U pseudolabels; WiSig real-gain expert is F-free. Parent and incremental costs remain separate.
Source V panels and prior results repeatedly exposed; no target IQ, truth or test statistics used in training. Fixed source screen and same-packet controls as preregistered.
